notes.title: Patch notes 0.5.0.4
notes.notes:
- Changed how Staff restock. Now they will know the last product a particular shelf spot held before being empty and check if you have it available in your inventory. This way players can maintain their store organized.
- Fixed a bug mixing jobs when a staff was set to do just one particular job like cleaning or restocking.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.5.0.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed staff energy not recovering after giving them a day off.
- Fixed staff working as cashier not counting sales for tasks

notes.title: Staff Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, managers. It's time to get more help for your mart!
Just hire them and relax while they do most of the work for you.

As always, keep giving all the feedback you have, please! We love it and you really help us to shape the game for the better <3[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice time!
Next step will be the addition of Staff and First Person Camera.[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.4.9.6
notes.notes:
- Added more inventory space to “Small Store” layout.
- Added more refrigerated inventory space to “Large Store” layout.
- Changed how auto camera angle works on multiplayer, for a better experience.
- Fixed players spawning inside store expansion area while still under construction.
- Fixed translation texts on some buttons not translating accordingly.
- Fixed delivery spot orientation on “Small Store”, so boxes are delivered with the correct rotation, as other store layouts.

notes.title: Local Multiplayer Update!
notes.notes:
Hey, managers. It's time to get some help for your mart! 

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
With local multiplayer, you can now play with three other friends, splitting the work and having fun together. Steam Remote Play Together is also enabled, so even being local multiplayer, you can still play with friends online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42431014/e1b92de506b25ddaf185e4d75d8a1bd9c884993e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42431014/6c640cad177d043bc28841e6ff98026bac4d059a.png[/img]

[h3]Soccer minigame[/h3]
We have also added a soccer minigame that started just as a ball easter egg, but we had so much fun playing it, that we decided to transform it into a complete local multiplayer minigame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42431014/05bb40441037a909e48bdcade944a734fda165ab.png[/img]

As always, keep giving all the feedback you have, please! We love it and you really help us to shape the game for the better <3

Next step will be the addition of Staff and First Person Camera. We'll certainly have patches in-between and new smaller things may be added there. Let us know your ideas here or through our Discord Server.

Patch notes 0.4.9.3:
- Added local multiplayer up for 4 players and Steam Remote Play Together.
- Changed how discount paper selection works to be more in line with other selection systems.
- Fixed gamepad selection pointer not appearing on PC UI.
- Fixed a bug not letting players scroll properly on the PC Shop menu when using a gamepad.
- Fixed some buttons not being translated or stuck at the first language selected.
- Other small fixes for visual or gameplay bugs.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.7.9
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug making players interact with unwanted things due to positioning.
- Fixed customer’s email asking for items named [item].
- Reworked how PC UI functions to fix a bug of it not receiving correct mouse inputs.
- Changed Cart, Discount and Tools stand positions on Mini and Small stores for better access to these item and be like Medium and Large ones.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.7.7
notes.notes:
- Fixed Refrigerated Products loosing health status faster when used on the Juice Machine Utility.
- Fixed machinery breaking with a high frequency.
- Fixed a bug resetting game resolution when opening the main menu.
- Fixed not being able to use last two boxes when players have more than 4 boxes on your cart.
- Changed how the interaction system works to be more precise about the item players are trying to interact.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.7.3
notes.notes:
- Added windowed mode
- Fixed settings options submenu not being scrollable when there’re more options than screen space.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.7.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed Refrigerated Products loosing health status faster when used on the Juice Machine Utility
- Fixed machinery breaking with a high frequency.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.7.0
notes.notes:
- Fixed main character stuck inside or on top of furniture
- Fixed boxes stuck on the invisible ceiling.
- Fixed Tutorial guy floating bug when starting a new game.
- Fixed World UI positioning being incorrectly due to resolution or UI scale options.
- Fixed PC UI not working properly for some screens and game resolutions.
- Rebalanced shelves, floors and walls  prices to be more affordable and easier to customize your mart more often.
- Added key bindings on “Z/J”, “X/K” and “C/L” keyboard keys to act like the three mouse buttons used to interact with items. This is just a workaround for players using just a trackpad, who may find easier to use keyboard keys instead. We’ll have key remapping on a future update.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.6.6
notes.notes: - Added a redundant system that creates different save file backups before and after a corruption state, making players able to roll back to functioning save states if needed.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.6.4
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Just some small fixes today. New stuff coming during this next week!

v0.4.6.4 changelog:
-Fixed products that weren’t food but displayed spoil time.
-Fixed some shelves displaying inversed input order when interacting.
-Fixed hats and eyes customization not saving/loading.

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.notes:
Hey managers!

First of all, thank you very much for all the love we are receiving from you <3

After seeing you playing the game and also giving a lot of feedback, we have been doing some updates since launch.
Today's update include a lot of important things to make your experience much better!

Changelog:
- Rebalanced payouts. Pressing all prompted buttons right, grants a tip at the end. Angry customers don't tip.
- Customers with friendship achieved, give bigger tips.
- Increased the amount of items being unlocked after completing tasks.
- Added a long hair character customization option when starting a new game.
- Added a way to change the song playing, on pause menu.
- Fully added gamepad support.
- Customers will only want products that are unlocked.
- Fixed buttons sizes on locker, when player is using 4k resolutions.
- Fixed a bug where you would receive products not yet unlocked, when starting a new game.

Please, continue to help shape Super Mini Mart. We have a lot of updates planned and your feedback is super important. <3
